reasoning: The 10-K details inventory valuation methods (adjusted standard cost approximating average or FIFO) and write-down policies. The 10-Q states there are no material changes to critical accounting policies, but doesn't reiterate the specifics of the inventory policy, which is a critical accounting policy. This omission could be problematic if the reader only reviews the 10-Q.

The Audit Committee has reviewed our disclosures relating to our critical accounting policies and estimates in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
Inventories
Inventory cost is computed on an adjusted standard basis, which approximates actual cost on an average or first-in, first-out basis.
